meta.description: Plug-and-play provider registry. Each provider declares its env-var slots, CRUD actions, remote_select (dropdown) and remote_list (collection) schemas, and logs/metrics hooks. Cards activate purely from env-var presence.

fields.status.connectedWhen: all required envVars resolve non-empty server-side

statusRules.activation: reactive — recomputed on each console load from GET /api/hub/providers/status
statusRules.connectedWhen: every envVar with required:true is present and non-empty in the server environment
statusRules.inactiveBehavior: card greyed, 'Not Connected' badge, all actions disabled; fills the moment its required env vars are set + redeployed
statusRules.security: env values are NEVER sent to the client; the status endpoint returns only booleans per provider
